skills.name: evidence-verification-unified
skills.description: Verify current facts about models, software releases, policies, people, organizations, and public web pages using authoritative sources, bounded retrieval, explicit uncertainty, and identity checks.

skills.name: session-workspace-cleanup
skills.description: Safely clean explicitly requested session workspace temporary artifacts while preserving sessions, memory, skills, user files, audit evidence, and active work.

skills.name: xdsh-approval-first-evolution
skills.description: Turn a discovered reusable workflow into a bounded, reviewable Skill proposal without ever mutating a bundled or user-owned Skill automatically.

skills.name: xdsh-artifact-quality
skills.description: Produce usable reports and files with a declared audience, structured claims, inspectable outputs, and a final quality check before delivery.

skills.name: xdsh-bounded-delegation
skills.description: Delegate genuinely independent work to isolated subagents with shared budgets, explicit receipts, parent verification, and coordinated cancellation.

skills.name: xdsh-bounded-investigation
skills.description: Investigate repositories or workspace evidence with bounded tool use, parallel branches, explicit source tracking, and a concise evidence-backed conclusion.

skills.name: xdsh-context-budget
skills.description: Keep long conversations within the configured model window using structured usage, safe-boundary compaction, and provenance-preserving continuation.

skills.name: xdsh-deep-research
skills.description: Research multi-source or disputed questions with bounded retrieval, claim-matched sources and explicit uncertainty. Simple facts need no broad investigation.

skills.name: xdsh-direct-execution
skills.description: Choose the shortest safe path from the user's goal to a verified result, batching independent work and avoiding speculative detours.

skills.name: xdsh-evidence-reporting
skills.description: Produce concise reports that separate observed facts, inferences, decisions, and unresolved questions with traceable source references.

skills.name: xdsh-failure-recovery
skills.description: Recover from task failures with explicit transient, terminal, and unknown states, idempotency checks, bounded retries, and preserved partial work.

skills.name: xdsh-long-task-control
skills.description: Run multi-step work with an explicit Todo, visible milestones, bounded retries, liveness checks, and a useful partial result when stopped.

skills.name: xdsh-memory-hygiene
skills.description: Keep durable USER, MEMORY, and session context useful through bounded redaction, provenance, deduplication, and explicit user authority.

skills.name: xdsh-safe-external-access
skills.description: Use Web, MCP, browser, or media capabilities only through XDSH's authenticated allowlisted boundary with bounded resources and credential-safe output.

skills.name: xdsh-skill-routing
skills.description: Select only relevant Skills through metadata-first progressive disclosure, explicit activation, trust boundaries, and bounded context injection.

skills.name: xdsh-testing-verification
skills.description: Validate an XDSH change with isolated tests, exact commands, and evidence proportional to its runtime and safety risk.
